limitations: One durable operation, four crop identities (none, legacy centered and two rectangles), invalid input, cancellation, confirmed publication and receipt reload after restart. Save is abstracted after successful current-source admission and durable acknowledgement; no fairness is assumed.

Four exact Android JVM tests execute production native bitmap rotation/cropping, invalid-edge validation, real JSON/SharedPreferences receipt persistence and the production receipt identity functions. The existing plain-JVM rectangle and copy-recovery suites remain separate owning checks.

The finite model is receipt identity, not complete photo-session restoration or crash-safe MediaStore refinement. Decode, original-source/permission revisions, failed image encoding, concurrent library changes, original Replace and provider durability remain separate existing owners. Actual consumer instrumentation and controlled Android recordings qualify selected real-byte flows separately.
